name: Shattering-Cover Projection VC Dimension / Interpolation Degree
details: No reverse one-sided comparison rescues the refuted equality: on $\mathcal C_{\mathrm{rev}}=\{0110,0111,1000,1001\}$, $\mathrm{SCVC}=1$ while $\mathrm{intdeg}=2$.
proof: The projection to $\{x_1,x_2,x_3\}$ has trace $\{011,100\}$, whose empty set and three singleton coordinates are shattered, while its VC dimension is one; it is therefore SCVC-admissible. Degree-one polynomials have only rank three on the four original concepts, whereas degree-two polynomials have rank four. Thus $\mathrm{SCVC}(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{rev}})=1<2=\mathrm{intdeg}(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{rev}})$.
